page_title: HOF 3-0 AUG | Hoffenheim v Augsburg 29/11/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+5' There will be no more action in this match as the referee signals full time.
90+3' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) tries to play a long through ball into Samuel Essende, but the defence breaks the move down.
90+1' Robin Hranac (Hoffenheim) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
90' The fourth official shows 4 min. of added time.
90' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

89' Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg) has a sight of goal, fires a shot in from distance towards the roof of the net and forces a good save out of Oliver Baumann. Augsburg have been awarded a corner kick.
89' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
88' The current number of corner kicks is 7:1.
87' The ball flies way wide of the left post as Marius Wolf (Augsburg) produces an imprecise volley strike from long distance.
86' Phillip Tietz (Augsburg) sends a superb lead pass into the penalty area and finds Alexis Claude-Maurice, who fails to shoot.
85' Tim Lemperle will be replaced by Muhammed Damar (Hoffenheim).
84' The goal by Augsburg won't count as it has been disallowed due to offside on the advice of the video assistant referee!
84' Wait! Referee Christian Dingert has indicated he is going to review the Augsburg goal using VAR. It’s probably to see if there was an offside in the build-up.

83' Phillip Tietz slides a pass towards Samuel Essende (Augsburg) who unleashes a fabulous shot from long range. The ball goes behind the surprised goalkeeper and into the top right corner. The score is now 3:1.
82' That's the end of the game for Anton Kade, who is replaced by Alexis Claude-Maurice (Augsburg).
81' Elvis Rexhbecaj (Augsburg) nicely brought down the pass, but his long-range effort was wild and went well wide of the right post.
80' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) releases Robin Fellhauer with a precise pass and he attempts to finish, but is immediately surrounded by the defenders and loses the ball.
79' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) takes a short corner kick.
78' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. The ball is out of play and Hoffenheim manage to earn a corner.
77' That was close by Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim)! He receives a pass on the edge of the box and shoots, but the ball goes by a whisker over the crossbar.
77' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
76' The total number of attempts is 15:11. 3:3 – this is the current number of shots on target.
74' Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim) makes a bad tackle on his opponent and is angry when the referee shows him a deserved yellow card.

73' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) strikes the ball towards goal, but it fails to reach the target after being well blocked by one of the defenders. Anton Kade (Augsburg) blows an opportunity as he sends a rebound from just outside of the box narrowly wide of the left post.
73' Marius Wolf (Augsburg) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
72' Grischa Promel goes off the pitch and Alexander Prass (Hoffenheim) comes on.
72' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Bernardo walks off the pitch to be replaced by Ozan Kabak (Hoffenheim).
71' Here is a change. Cedric Zesiger is going off and Sandro Wagner gives the last tactical orders to Marius Wolf (Augsburg).
71' A substitution has been made. Dimitrios Giannoulis is replaced by Phillip Tietz (Augsburg).
70' A pass from Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) is intercepted by Finn Dahmen and the move breaks down.
68' The attendance is 20218.
66' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear.
66' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Augsburg force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
64' Andrej Kramaric finds Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) unmarked on the edge of the box, but his thunderbolt of shot goes high over the bar.
62' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Oliver Baumann, who smothers the ball.
60' Anton Kade (Augsburg) clips a neat ball into the box in the direction of Samuel Essende, but he can't get on the end of the pass.
60' Christian Ilzer decides to make a substitution. Bazoumana Toure will be replaced by Max Moerstedt (Hoffenheim).
59' Substitution. Fisnik Asllani walks off the pitch and Andrej Kramaric (Hoffenheim) comes on as a substitute.
58' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Oliver Baumann intercepts the ball.
57' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) sends in the corner, but the keeper steps in and makes a save.
56' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him. The linesman makes the right call and Hoffenheim will have a corner.

56' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) gets in a good position inside the box and is only inches away from getting on the end of a through ball from the edge of the area. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Augsburg.
53' Anton Kade (Augsburg) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
50' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) pounces on a pass inside the box but flashes his shot just over the bar. That was a great chance!
49' Bernardo (Hoffenheim) is in a clear offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
47' Kristijan Jakic (Augsburg) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Christian Dingert blows for a foul. Hoffenheim are awarded a free kick. Let's see what they create from this.
46' The game is over for Han-Noah Massengo (Augsburg). Elvis Rexhbecaj comes on for the second half.
46' The need to improve in the second half has brought about a change. Mert Komur (Augsburg) comes off for Kristijan Jakic.
46' Referee Christian Dingert blows his whistle to start the second half.
45+3' The match has reached half-time.
45' 2 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' 3 - 0 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Cedric Zesiger (Augsburg), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it into the bottom right corner of his own goal.
44' Robin Fellhauer (Augsburg) breaks past challenges inside the box, but puts too much pace on his pass to Mert Komur.
44' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) rises high to connect with a lofted pass inside the box, but one of his opponents is in the right place at the right time to thwart him.
42' Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim) might have got lucky there after the VAR review resulted in referee Christian Dingert deciding not to issue any card.

41' It's been a while since that contentious challenge by Oliver Baumann (Hoffenheim), but referee Christian Dingert must have received some information as he makes the VAR signal. He's going to review and it could result in a red card!
41' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) takes the rebound on the edge of the box and fires the ball just over the crossbar.
40' The ball is cleared after Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) attempted to dribble past an opposing player.
38' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) fizzes over a cross which doesn't cause any problems.
37' The game is interrupted, a clear handball by Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim).
34' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) runs onto a ball from Bazoumana Toure and tries an ambitious shot from mid-range. The keeper has it covered but it goes just over the bar anyway.
33' Samuel Essende (Augsburg) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender.
33' The ball is laid off to Mert Komur (Augsburg) on the edge of the box. He shoots through a crowd of players towards the middle of the goal and forces Oliver Baumann to make a decent save.
31' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 11:2. Shots on target – 3:1.
30' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender.

26' 2 - 0 Grischa Promel fires in a promising shot which ricochets off the goalkeeper back to Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) inside the box. He unleashes a quick shot into the top of the net. The score is 2:0.
24' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) swings in a cross from the corner, but Finn Dahmen reads it well and gathers the ball.
23' Leon Avdullahu (Hoffenheim) gets to the rebound and shoots, but the effort is blocked. The referee signals a corner kick to Hoffenheim.
23' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) has the ability to send the ball deep into the penalty area from throw-ins and it can lead to very promising situations for his team.
21' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) is caught offside!
20' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
20' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) shoots inside the box, but is denied by a timely block. Good work from Hoffenheim as they win a corner.
19' Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) unleashes a beautiful mid-range volley to the left side of the goal, but his effort is thwarted by the keeper, and the score remains the same.
19' The percentage of ball possession is – 68:32.

16' 1 - 0 Wouter Burger feeds the ball through to Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 1:0!
15' Grischa Promel (Hoffenheim) is first to the cross from Vladimir Coufal, but fires his header just past the left post from close range.
15' The Hoffenheim players are exchanging some short passes.
13' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) stretches for the loose ball inside the box and rifles a volley just over the bar.
12' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) serves up a nice cross, but Finn Dahmen punches the ball away.
12' Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) takes the corner with a short pass.
11' Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) reacts well to latch onto a rebound inside the box, but his shot is well blocked. The ball goes out for a corner. Hoffenheim can continue in their attacking effort.
10' Tim Lemperle (Hoffenheim) sent a pass onto Fisnik Asllani, who didn't get a chance to finish.

7' Fabian Rieder (Augsburg) attempts to release Anton Kade with a through ball, but his effort is thwarted by one of the defending players. A rebound bounces out to Samuel Essende (Augsburg) on the edge of the box, but he can't control his shot and it slips well wide of the right post.
6' Neat link-up play between Dimitrios Giannoulis (Augsburg) and Samuel Essende, but Oliver Baumann reads the game well and the move breaks down.
5' The resulting corner from Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) comes to nothing.
4' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. Hoffenheim force a corner. They send men into the box.
4' Corner kick. Vladimir Coufal (Hoffenheim) is ready to send the ball into the box.
4' Bazoumana Toure (Hoffenheim) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The referee blows his whistle, Hoffenheim are awarded a corner kick.

3' A through ball from Fisnik Asllani (Hoffenheim) fails to reach Tim Lemperle as one of the defending players reacts brilliantly to intercept the effort. If the pass had been produced a little bit earlier, Tim Lemperle could have got into a promising position.
2' Wouter Burger (Hoffenheim) brings down his opponent with a very late tackle.
1' Here we go, today's match is starting right now.
Augsburg will kick-off.
Christian Dingert got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
